OFFICE NO. NOTE 2 06.01.2025 GRKP, J  Heard Sri E. Venkata Rao, learned Counsel  appearing on behalf of Sri K. Maheswara Rao,
 learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner, Sri Sridhar  Tummalapudi, learned Counsel for the  Respondent No.1 and Sri Arjun Chowdary,
learned Asst. Government Pleader.

2. The facts on record would indicate that the Writ Petitioner, having been dissatisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded through the Award, has filed a Petition (Ex.P.7) under Section 3 (a) of the National Highway Authority of India Act, 1956 as well as under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 (Ex.P.7).

sentences.text: It transpires from the record that the said Petition has been filed by the Writ Petitioner way back on 09.08.2018.

3. Learned Asst. Government Pleader has submitted the Written Instructions dated:
19.12.2024, furnished by the Joint Collector,
SL. DATE ORDER OFFICE NO. NOTE Kakinada.
Copy of it is supplied to the learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner and the same is taken on record.

4. The said Written Instructions would indicate that, in the present case, there is no dispute either with regard to the title or with regard to the apportionment of compensation and that the Petition filed by the Writ Petitioner requesting to pay the enhanced compensation is under consideration of the Arbitrator and District Collector and the said Petition will be disposed of in due course.
5. Having regard to the fact that the Writ Petitioner has filed the Petition way back on 09.08.2018,
this Court is completely dissatisfied with the nature of the Written Instructions dated:
19.12.2024 rendered by the Joint Collector, Kakinada.

6. Therefore, the District Collector, Kakinada District (Respondent No.3) is directed to furnish the Written Instructions as regards the status of the Petition filed by the Writ Petitioner dated: 09.08.2018 (Ex.P.7) and the time-line within which the Pilli Arjunna vs The Union Of India on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150278521/
